title: One of my favorite garlands.
text: One of my favorite garlands.. I've had this garland before and loved it. It comes in 6 ft length, but i use my wire cutters and cut it in to sections and lay it around my Christmas decorations. I hate to see decorations just sitting there by themselves. Just a little touch of this garland makes all the diference. Don't be discouraged when you take it out of the wrapper, it looks like a tangled mess, but if you take your time and bend the different branches it's really nice. Love the wispy look of it. One of my favorites. P.S. This looks great with your fall/thanksgiving decorations too.
